description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of responses across three categories – Deceived, Partially, and Not Deceived – for two levels of ambiguity, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)”. The chart contains six slices in total, representing the proportion of each response category within each ambiguity level. For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the “Deceived” category is represented by a red slice and comprises approximately 67.6% of the total, while the “Partially” category is shown in yellow and accounts for roughly 57.9%. The “Not Deceived” category is represented by a green slice and occupies about 10.5% of the chart. For Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the “Deceived” category is shown in red and represents approximately 31.6%, the “Partially” category is yellow and accounts for about 23.5%, and the “Not Deceived” category is green and occupies roughly 8.8% of the chart. A legend is provided to identify the color coding for each response category, and percentage labels are included directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest proportions appearing first for each ambiguity level.
